reviewer: Claude Code (Opus, orchestrating session) — self-review of its own changes and of the two Sonnet implementation agents' summary-image work

importantFindings.title: The first image renderer broke on the owner's Android phone
importantFindings.evidence: Owner report of 2026-10-04 on the deployed 71a01a7: names wrapped after a few letters with room to spare and were drawn over the next line, double names broke, the 'Equipaggi senza barca' heading ran under the cards and third lines left the card. Playwright on Windows and Linux had shown a faithful image: the SVG foreignObject laid the text out again with the phone's own measurements while every box kept its frozen on-screen size.
importantFindings.disposition: Fixed in 5580d33: the image is painted from the screen's own layout (boxes, borders, radii, clips, each word's Range rects, logos and icons), so it keeps the screen's line breaks; each text node's size is calibrated against its on-screen word widths. New browser checks require ink for every on-screen word and none outside a card, and prove the image survives text measuring 18% wider or 15% narrower than the page. The owner confirmed the image on Android on 2026-10-05.

importantFindings.title: The iPhone copy and share are verified on the WebKit engine and in unit tests, not on an iPhone
importantFindings.evidence: Playwright WebKit makes the image (logos, icons, similarity) and its clipboard write succeeds; Safari's promise-valued clipboard item and the Condividi share sheet on a real iPhone are not exercised.
importantFindings.disposition: Accepted for F4; the owner checks it on an iPhone at UG2. No simulated PASS is recorded.

importantFindings.title: The image is copied and shared, never saved by the app
importantFindings.evidence: A web app cannot write into the gallery; on 2026-10-04 the owner found the download redundant with the copied image and asked to remove it.
importantFindings.disposition: Done in 5580d33: Copia immagine copies; Condividi opens the share sheet (WhatsApp, Salva immagine) where the phone can share files.

qolFindings.title: At 320 px with 200% text the button wraps to two lines and its note covers much of the screen
qolFindings.evidence: scratchpad screenshot f4-crew-summary-button-320-200pct.png (synthetic data, not stored).
qolFindings.disposition: Accepted: the stress case stays usable, the note hides after about six seconds, and the last card stays clear of the button at the end of the scroll (browser test).

qolFindings.title: The offline browser test runs on the dev server, which has no service worker
qolFindings.disposition: Accepted: it proves the cache and decoded-pixel fallback; the precache of the eight brand images is asserted on the production build by scripts/check-built-pwa.mjs, and the owner confirmed the installed app offline on 2026-10-03.

qolFindings.title: At 320 px a long first name can break mid-word on screen, and so in the image
qolFindings.evidence: Synthetic 'Francesca', 'Alessandro' at 320 CSS px in two columns (scratchpad f4b images, synthetic data).
qolFindings.disposition: Accepted: the image reproduces the screen; ordinary phones are 360 px or wider. Recorded for the owner.

qolFindings.title: One browser batch timed out the double-names journey right after npm run verify
qolFindings.disposition: Load: it passed alone (15 s), in its spec file in order, and in a clean rerun of the same batch (22 passed, 27 skipped).

checks: Free seat: CrewManagement.test.tsx 'fills a selected vacancy with an available volunteer, like a student' and tests/e2e/ux2-crew-interactions.spec.ts 'fills a chosen free seat with an available volunteer (F4)' (Pixel 7 Chrome, survives a reload). Both would fail on the old code, which opened the volunteer's destination chooser.

Image fidelity: every exported PNG reviewed by eye against the screen (13 crews, D1 10x4, long numbers, offline, the Comandate week, WebKit); the browser test compares the PNG with Playwright's own screenshot of the same content and rejects a blank, a 6 px shifted and a greyscale image on every run.

Code read in full: src/lib/pageSnapshot.ts, src/lib/summaryShare.ts, src/components/SummaryImageButton.tsx and the two views' diffs. The clipboard write starts synchronously inside the tap; a failed render reports nothing copied; the close button, the button and its note are excluded from the image; no new dependency.

Follow-up 2026-10-04: read src/lib/pageSnapshot.ts (recording, text runs and calibration, borders, clips, icons, cropping) and summaryShare.ts (copy in the tap, the dev-only test hook absent from the production build, checked on the live bundle). Reviewed every follow-up PNG against its screen reference: 13 crews, double names at 390, 320 and 320 px/200%, the Comandate week at three sizes, WebKit, DejaVu Sans and the bent-canvas cases.
Fixed a layout bug the new images revealed: the Comandate day label grew with the text in a fixed 34px column and ran into the names at 320 px/200%; the column is now 2.25rem.
Owner, 2026-10-05, on the deployed 5580d33 (Android): copying and pasting the crew and Comandate images, the summary without unplaced volunteers, and the blue Home cards are all good.
